app-templates.message:
feat(quiz): the quiz runtime as the package @lernapps/app-templates, a knowledge quiz

## Intent

Apps should depend on their archetype's runtime as a package, so a new feature such as a timer reaches an app with a dependency bump. And quizzes are mostly about things to know: every option needs short background knowledge, every question further reading.

## Key changes

- The repo root is the package @lernapps/app-templates, installed from git at a commit, since npm cannot install a subfolder. It exports the quiz engine, the Vite build step, the stylesheet, the generic Playwright tests and the schema, which now names the runtime package.
- @lernapps/tooling and Playwright are optional peer dependencies, so installing the runtime needs nothing else from GitHub.
- The template uses the runtime of its own commit and composes it with the shared preset: `lernapps({ plugins: [quiz()] })`.
- Options have `text`, `correct`, `info` and an optional `link`; questions have an `explanation` and at least one link; the quiz may list `sources`. Per-option feedback is gone.
- After an answer, and in the answer key without JavaScript, the page shows every option's background with the right option and the learner's choice marked, then the explanation and the links.
- The example bank "Naturwunder der Welt" has eight questions of all six types, written in own words from the German Wikipedia articles it links.
- The unit tests of the scoring move here with the code.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling removes its copy of the runtime and points the generator at this package (9e0982f and the commits after it on the branch of tooling#36).
- The template has no lockfile; the app's first install writes it.

tooling.message:
refactor(quiz): the quiz runtime moves to @lernapps/app-templates, a knowledge quiz

## Intent

An archetype's runtime should be a package the app depends on, in lernapps/app-templates, so a new feature reaches an app with a dependency bump; the tooling stays a development dependency. The quiz becomes a quiz about things to know.

## Key changes

- Engine, build step, stylesheet, generic tests, schema and scoring tests leave the tooling. The tooling never depends on the runtime.
- The generator points the app's @lernapps/app-templates at the commit it copied the template from, and lists the archetypes it knows with the pin.
- The schema keeps its URL on the tooling's docs site; the docs build takes it from app-templates at the pinned commit.
- The skill lernapps-quiz describes the new bank with the natural-wonders example; new rules quiz-further-reading and quiz-own-words (both warnings).
- The architecture records the decision dec-runtime-package.
- The generator test checks background, marks, explanation and links after each answer and in the answer key.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the runtime package in app-templates (bcaf577, 3a83657, app-templates#4); the pin moves to the head of that branch.

## Intent

Two apps checked at the same time, as in the tooling's own parallel tests, both served on port 4317, and the second run failed.

## Key changes

- The shared Playwright configuration takes a free port when it loads and passes it to its workers; a port set from outside is used as it is.
